# Florida Impact Windows & Doors

> Installer of hurricane impact windows and doors. Not a manufacturer. Not a Fort Lauderdale headquarters. Not an authorized-dealer claim.

## Entity

- Legal / brand name: Florida Impact Windows & Doors
- Address: 3000 Stirling Rd, Hollywood, FL 33021
- Phone: (754) 600-4876
- Email: info@floridaimpactwindowsdoors.com
- Website: https://floridaimpactwindowsdoors.com
- Hours: Mon–Fri 8:00–18:00, Sat 9:00–15:00
- Service area: Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach counties
- Brands installed: PGT, CGI, ES Windows, Custom Window Systems (CWS). Installation is not an authorized-dealer claim.
- Code: Miami-Dade + Broward = High-Velocity Hurricane Zone (typically Miami-Dade NOA on replacement glass). Palm Beach = wind-borne debris region (Florida Product Approval / FL# often accepted). We do not invent license numbers, review counts, or years in business.
